#### Selection and adaptation

Runtime ownership: `auto-init`. No dedicated entry in the reviewed Google component inventory.

Public JavaScript exports: `TreemapChart`. See the [API index](../references/api-index.md).

Example: A budget split across twelve teams is a treemap chart. Revenue split across three plans is a pie chart.

#### Material mapping

Relationship: none. Web extension; no dedicated entry was observed in the reviewed current M3 component inventory.

Support: Rectangles drawn from a figure's data table, one per row of the first value column with its area in proportion to the total, in a squarified layout that mirrors in right-to-left pages, with names and cells written in rectangles that hold them, no rectangle for cells that are not positive numbers, six colors, update(), data-watch, and a pointer and keyboard tooltip with each row's share that steps through rows in table order.

Web adaptation: The <table> stays in the page as the text alternative and the no-JavaScript fallback; the rectangles are aria-hidden and the plot is one Tab stop with a polite live tooltip.

Known boundary: There is one level only: no parent groups, legend, drill-down or animated update().

Full parity remains unassessed. Review provenance and specification links: [capability evidence](../references/capability-roadmap.md#treemap-chart).

#### Contract

Parts of a whole drawn as rectangles whose areas follow their values, filling the plot.

A `<figure class="treemap-chart">` takes the same `<figcaption>` and `<table>` as a pie chart. `AutoInit()` draws each row of the first value column as a rectangle whose share of the plot's area is its share of the total, with its name and cell written inside it, and a tooltip that follows the pointer. The table stays in the page, visually hidden, as the chart's text alternative; without JavaScript it shows instead of the chart.

#### Syntax

```html
<figure class="treemap-chart">
  <figcaption>Budget by team</figcaption>
  <table>
    <thead>
      <tr><th>Team</th><th>Budget</th></tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><th>Engineering</th><td>$600,000</td></tr>
      <tr><th>Research</th><td>$300,000</td></tr>
      <tr><th>Design</th><td>$120,000</td></tr>
      <tr><th>Sales</th><td>$80,000</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</figure>
```

#### Also documented

The Treemap chart section of the [API reference](https://www.expressivecss.com/llm.md) also covers Tokens.

#### Rules

- `treemap-chart-is-a-figure-with-a-table`: Write .treemap-chart as a <figure> holding a <table> of the data. The drawn chart is hidden from assistive technology, so the table is all a screen reader reads, and it is what shows without JavaScript.
- `treemap-chart-has-a-caption`: Name a .treemap-chart with a <figcaption>. It names the focusable plot as well as the figure; hide it with .visually-hidden when nearby text already names the chart.
